product_name: Bajaj Life Smart Wealth Goal VI
regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Maturity Benefit equal to the Fund Value on the date of maturity; payable even on death/ATPD during the term (Child Wealth variant)

Death or Accidental Total Permanent Disability (ATPD) Benefit: Prevailing Sum Assured plus prevailing Top-up Sum Assured, subject to a minimum Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid till date of death
Income Benefit: an additional installment equal to one prevailing Annualized Premium paid each policy year till end of term on death/ATPD (Child Wealth variant)
Waiver of Premium (WOP) Benefit: all future premiums paid by the Company on death/ATPD during the premium paying term
Loyalty Benefits: Return of Premium Allocation Charge (ROAC) and Fund Boosters added to the Regular Premium Fund value
Return of Mortality Charge (ROMC), Return of Income Benefit Charge (ROIBC), Return of Morbidity Charge (ROMBC) and Return of Waiver of Premium Charge (ROWC) added at maturity, subject to conditions
Choice of five investment portfolio strategies and multiple unit-linked funds; Systematic Partial Withdrawal
Option to receive Maturity Benefit in installments with Return Enhancer; Family Benefit for existing-customer families
riders_available: Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (UIN 116A060V01)

eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single (Wealth & Joint Life Wealth variants only) and Limited / Regular premium payment
eligibility.note: Eligibility table present in brochure but specific numeric age / term / sum-assured boundaries not recovered from this parse; Maximum Sum Assured and Min/Max Premium stated to be 'as per the Board Approved Underwriting Policy (BAUP)'.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for yearly, half-yearly and quarterly premium frequencies; 15 days for monthly frequency.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death due to suicide within 12 months from the date of commencement of the Policy or latest revival (whichever is later), the nominee/beneficiary is entitled to the Fund Value as available on the date of intimation of death; any charges (other than FMC or guarantee charge) recovered after the date of death are added back to the Fund Value.
key_terms.lock_in_note: Unit Linked Insurance Products do not offer any liquidity during the first five years; the policyholder cannot surrender or withdraw monies completely or partially till the end of the fifth year (five-year lock-in).
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: Death/ATPD benefit is subject to a minimum Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid till the date of death; this is the only guaranteed element (the rest is market-linked Fund Value).
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefit may be as per prevailing tax laws; GST applicable as per prevailing tax laws, subject to amendment from time to time.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Grievance Redressal & IRDAI Grievance Call Centre (IGCC) details
'Returns at 4% and 8% are illustrative and not guaranteed' disclosure on the benefit illustration
'This brochure should be read in conjunction with the Benefit Illustration and policy document' statement

claims_marketing_must_support: This card is for the CHILD WEALTH variant; benefits such as Income Benefit and WOP described here are variant-specific — any benefit claim must be qualified to the correct variant (Wealth / Child Wealth / Joint Life Wealth).
Any '105% guaranteed' / 'guaranteed benefit' claim is bounded ONLY to the minimum death/ATPD benefit (105% of Total Premiums Paid) — it does not guarantee maturity value or returns.
Maturity Benefit equals the Fund Value (market-linked), not a guaranteed maturity amount.
Single-premium option is available ONLY for the Wealth and Joint Life Wealth variants, not Child Wealth.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'assured returns' / 'risk-free' language — this is a Unit-Linked plan and investment risk is borne entirely by the policyholder.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating; 'Loyalty Benefits', ROAC, ROMC etc. are charge-return features, not bonuses.
Do NOT present illustrative 4% / 8% return figures as expected, guaranteed, or upper/lower limits of returns.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first five years — ULIP funds are locked in and cannot be surrendered or partially withdrawn during the five-year lock-in.
Do NOT position fund-value growth as guaranteed; only the 105%-of-premiums minimum death benefit is guaranteed.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan'
ULIP market-risk disclosure: investment in ULIPs is subject to capital-market risks and the policyholder is solely responsible for his/her investment decisions
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions
